reviews.text: Balatro meets Vampire Survivors. Have been hooked on this game since the demo, very happy to see it released. The gameplay loop is simple enough in that on lower difficulties it can feel like an idler but beating the higher difficulties will require borderline mathematical analysis. A lot of different builds you can run, all of which are really satisfying when you figure out the right combination of items to start accelerating. It's hard to put down after one run, feels like crack cocaine in a way in that you keep trying for another shot, then again I'm obsessed with roguelike round-based games. Would like to see some DLC (free preferably) in the future, maybe some more variety in bosses and levels. Otherwise it's perfect

First run: Made it 7 levels in, crushed completely, no chance Second run: Had to intentionally die after 100+ rounds of Endless mode because the game was lagging too hard from the sheer density of things happening on screen Yeah this one has The Sauce™

注定是个创意小游戏~连接模组产生协同效果的玩法很有趣，但上限实在是有点低，摆放模组的格子数量是固定的，模组只能升一级，那格子摆满模组升满就只能挂机了，甚至没有打无尽模式的必要(虽然游戏有无尽模式)；目前用法杖流通了关，说实话，初始角色带的物理兵器流派还有我尝试了的宠物流派都有些弱，在面对远程敌人和自爆敌人的时候很难及时处理，而且面对堆怪的情况似乎只有法杖的AOE才有一战之力；另外就是商店池子有点深，我最后一把法杖升级是在最后一关刷出来的，感觉有点坑。

[b]Wireworks[/b] is a genuinely clever concept and a gameplay loop I haven’t really seen before. Routing signals and optimizing your setup scratches a very fresh kind of strategy itch. Unfortunately, the game is extremely light on content and ends before the system really has a chance to evolve. It feels more like a prototype for something that could have been much bigger with more development time. Because of that lack of content, I unfortunately can’t recommend it despite how fun the core idea is.

I will be echoing what several other reviews are saying in that Wireworks has an interesting premise that it does very little with. It plays more like a tech demo than a full game Pros: - Roguelike, one of my preferred game genres - Very simple gameplay loop, easy to learn - Interesting concept with some fun semi-realistic quirks, like cable management potentially blocking access to other ports in your current build - Clear and distinct upgrade paths with weapons, magic, and pets Cons: - Your customization ability is overly limited by a fairly small board and inventory size - All builds lead to "Spam as many projectiles as possible in as wide an area as possible" - An extension of the above, the game has no quality or graphic management options. This means that at high particle counts, the game will lag and you have no way as a player to do anything other than watch the slide show - Once you've completed a single run (which isn't difficult), you've essentially seen everything that the game can offer you

So it's 50% idler, 50% cable management. Which means I can spend a few seconds doing something in the game, then look away and focus on music for a while as my dumb orbs run around blowing things up, and then come back. This is deliberately targeted at my ADHD and I don't like it (complementary).

It feels more like a demo for a game. That lack of content is really depressing. Once you setup your "build", that's it. There's nothing else to do except do the next level. The inventory doesn't ever upgrade to make more elaborate builds and you can only upgrade stuff one time. It got boring before I even finished the first difficulty. There's no real achievements to work towards, just the bare bones "finish the game on this difficulty" garbage. It feels like there was no creativity behind the game. It's really disappointing overall. There's virtually no real depth to the seemingly complex inventory system. It just falls short of feeling like a good game. I would skip it unless it's less than like 3 bucks. Just not worth the current price tag.

6.5/10 创意小游戏，连线自走棋 看似有很多连线，实际上主要是分线器在干扰视线，本质上就是一层，运动/增益贴给武器。运动拼接收益有限，大多数时候单挂个波动或者圆周就凑合用了，格子主要得给增益。还有宠物这种完全不需要连线的流派。 也没特别差，但感觉就像是gamejam游戏，玩完了创意之后没什么东西。本身分数可以稍微高一点，不过这个分数的意思是“你应该抱着它只有这么多游玩量”的期待去玩。
